name: objection-handling
description: Handle sales objections using tactical empathy. Use when the user says "how do I handle this objection", "prospect said [X]", "they pushed back on price", "they said they're not ready", "how to respond to 'we already have a solution'", "they said 'send me more information'", "objection response", "they went dark after the proposal", "how to handle 'we don't have budget'", or wants to craft a response to a specific sales objection.
